findings.summary: Rows consume generated Uint8Array batches and do not load a full XML string.
Partial rows deliberately drop one or more string fields and are not StAX parity rows.
Full rows fold element names, text/CDATA, attribute names, and attribute values into the same checksum.
The fastest row in each family is a headroom signal, not a runtime-limit conclusion.
Projection rows report projected record counts and selected-field checksums, not full StAX event parity.
